name: Universal TV Scroll Snap
description: Adds scroll-snap behavior so pages scroll one section at a time for D-pad navigation

params.css: html { scroll-snap-type: y proximity !important; scroll-behavior: smooth !important; } section, article, [role='article'], main > div, .section, [class*='Section'], [class*='section-'] { scroll-snap-align: start !important; scroll-margin-top: 20px !important; }
